name BHEL HEEP COLLECTION A/C Account No. 10667995458 IFSC Code SBIN0000586 Bank Name SBI Branch address RANIPUR HARIDWAR . Bidder to indicate bid number and name of bidding entity in the transaction details field at the time of on- line transfer. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Payment online through RTGS / internet banking also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). On-line payment shall be in Beneficiary name BHEL HEEP COLLECTION A/C Account No. 10667995458 IFSC Code SBIN0000586 Bank Name SBI Branch address RANIPUR HARIDWAR . Successful Bidder to indicate Contract number and name of Seller entity in the transaction details field at the time of on-line transfer.
